title: Catalyst cluster.json
description: Schema for catalyst-cluster/cluster.json — the cluster-scope config. The canonical copy lives in the private coalesce-labs/catalyst-cluster repo (schema/cluster.schema.json); this is a vendored copy kept in the catalyst repo so all three Catalyst config scopes (repo = catalyst-config.schema.json, node = machine-config.schema.json, cluster = this file) are documented and testable together (CTL-1214). The project roster (projects[]) is the relocation target for each repo's deprecated Layer-1 monitor.linear.teams[]; the node roster (roster[]) is the relocation target for the retired .catalyst/hosts.json.

roster.description: Node roster — host names that are live cluster members (HRW ownership domain).

anchorIssue.description: Linear issue key used as the cluster liveness/quota anchor.

projects.description: Project roster — the fleet's team→repo→projectKey map (relocated from each project repo's monitor.linear.teams, design §13).

executorPolicy.description: CTL-2116: the fleet-wide per-phase executor-routing policy, written by `catalyst cluster route <verb>` and read live (uncached, no restart) by every host via readExecutorPolicy (execution-core/executor-policy.mjs). Outranks the per-host CATALYST_EXECUTOR_BY_PHASE env pin.

routes.description: phase -> executor id (e.g. "codex-exec", "sdk", "bg", "oneshot-legacy", or a compound alias like "claude-sdk"), stored verbatim. An empty object is a real policy (routes nothing), not absent.

codexBudgetFloorPercent.description: Operator-tunable floor (percent headroom) for the Scenario-3 command-time budget gate. Overridable per-command via CATALYST_CODEX_BUDGET_FLOOR_PERCENT; defaults to DEFAULT_CODEX_BUDGET_FLOOR_PERCENT (20) when absent.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent route change.

updatedBy.description: The `--by`/git-email/$USER identity that made the most recent route change.

history.description: Bounded (HISTORY_MAX = 20) newest-first audit trail. Each entry carries {id, at, by, host, change:{phase,from,to}, priorRoutes, rollbackOf?, forcedBudget?} — priorRoutes is the WHOLE prior routes map, not just the changed key, so rollback is an exact restore.
